newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow late Friday. Few sales of slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Inquiry was moderate, demand was rather light. Sales confirmed on 1,100 slaughter steers and 2,700 slaughter heifers. Last week's confirmed sales 66,800 head including 14,100 head or about 21 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - few select and choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 70.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 70.00, pen 69.50; select with end choice 69.00.
Confirmed: 3800 week ago: none year ago: 4000
